identityDecision: Use the centroid of the protected Rød Herregård main-building geometry as the stable physical anchor for the combined manor, museum and garden record.

historicalScope.source: Store norske leksikon – Rød, storgård i Halden kommune
historicalScope.finding: A seventeenth-century building and a 1733 addition form the core of the protected main house, which was altered in 1862 and enlarged in 1875. The house, park and site foundation must be distinguished from the much larger forest estate.
historicalScope.visitorIdentity: Østfoldmuseene's Rød Herregård department combines the manor house, historic collections, archives, yard and gardens.

crossChecks.finding: The manor entity is classified as cultural property, manor house and museum, links OSM way 4481504 and Kulturminne ID 86040, and lies approximately 9.2 metres from the applied building centroid.
The official museum identifies the public manor destination and gives the visitor address Herregårdsveien 10, 1771 Halden.
